taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空正式開航臺北至布拉格航線 首航班機由董事長張國煒親自執飛
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空於8月1日凌晨正式開通首條歐洲直飛航線，提供往返桃園國際機場（TPE）與捷克布拉格瓦茨拉夫・哈維爾機場（PRG）的載客服務。這項航線的啟動，代表星宇航空的營運版圖由既有的亞洲與北美市場，進一步延伸至中歐地區。 本次首航任務具備明顯指標意義，由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自駕駛執飛。星宇航空以空中巴士A350-900廣體客機執飛該航線，該機型以長程飛行效率、
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: STARLUX Airlines Officially Launches Taipei–Prague Route with Inaugural Flight Piloted Personally by Chairman Chang Kuo-wei
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: STARLUX Airlines officially launched its first direct European route in the early morning of August 1, operating passenger service between Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and Václav Havel Airport Prague (PRG) in the Czech Republic. The launch of this route marks the expansion of STARLUX's network from Asia and North America into Central Europe. Serving as a key milestone, the inaugural flight was personally piloted by STARLUX Airlines Chairman Chang Kuo-wei. STARLUX operates the route using Airbus A350-900 widebody aircraft, a model known for long-haul flight efficiency, cabin comfort, and a quieter cabin environment.

international_aviation.headline: 聯合航空表示無意購買阿聯酋航空預製777X
international_aviation.summary: Simple Flying報導，聯合航空對購買最多20架原屬阿聯酋航空的預製777X飛機「沒有興趣」，但為其他航空公司接手留下空間。此消息涉及777X機隊的潛在交易動態。
international_aviation.headline_en: United Airlines Says It Has "No Interest" in Ex-Emirates Pre-Built 777X Aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: Simple Flying reports that United Airlines has stated it has "no interest" in purchasing up to 20 pre-built 777X aircraft originally destined for Emirates. The airline has ruled out taking possession of these aircraft but left room for other carriers to step in.

new_information: United Airlines has stated it has "no interest" in purchasing pre-built 777X aircraft originally destined for Emirates.
Up to 20 such aircraft are involved, and United has ruled out taking possession while leaving room for other airlines to step in.
The 777X program received FAA approval to begin certification flight testing under Type Inspection Authorization 4B, with first delivery anticipated in 2027.
